text: Vera Dodic, Manager, Toronto Newcomer Office, Social Development, Finance and Administration, City of Toronto, and Muna Gaye, Community Development Officer, Toronto Newcomer Office, Social Development, Finance and Administration, City of Toronto, will give a presentation on Indigenous-Newcomer Relations in Toronto. The presentation will provide an update on the Toronto Newcomer Office's vision and plans to strengthen Indigenous-Newcomer relationships in Toronto in response to the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada's Calls to Action.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee received the item for information.
